scope: Candidate history, not a publication receipt. The final release must pass the current-source native motion fixture, existing gameplay/controller matrix and actual public-byte verification.
implementation_boundary: Original analytic leg solve, world-space contact state, cubic target offsets, authored procedural swim/tread curves and coherent rest-space body fitting. No third-party code, clips, models or training are claimed as newly imported. Existing licensed Quaternius derivatives stay unchanged on disk.

first_native_attempt.reason: After warm-up, downhill grade 0.3 repeatedly exceeded comfortable leg reach and released contacts; the test correctly rejected zero mature contact samples.
first_native_attempt.correction: Add a bounded visual pelvis adjustment based on lower neighboring support heights. Strengthen the model slope test to ignore warm-up and cover grades -0.57, -0.3, 0.3 and 0.57. Do not relax contact error tolerances.
first_native_attempt.additional_review_finding: Several decoded glTF material primitives share position/normal attributes. Clone all part geometries before applying one coherent fit, so shared attributes are not distorted once per material.
first_native_attempt.visual_review: The camera-matched source showed an overly long visible neck. Shorten that region and modestly enlarge the head while retaining the crown landmark, together with the existing shoulder/knee/boot refinements. The first swim fixture's land plane hid submerged limbs; move only its diagnostic basin floor and camera, not gameplay water.

retained_local_failures: The initial runtime research URL comment violated the public-boundary test; move URLs to GROUNDED.md rather than exempting runtime external endpoints.

An idempotent preparation edit originally duplicated imports on repeat integration. Check already-integrated new text first; restore known source and rerun all tests. These temporary scripts are removed before merge.

The original neck-connector test used the old uncalibrated height. Preserve its vertex count and coverage criterion against the same landmarks passed through the common proportion map, rather than deleting seam assertions.

evidence_classes.model: Deterministic time steps, solver degeneracies, mature plant residuals, terrain, state immutability, fitting and all earlier source/save rules.
evidence_classes.native_motion: Synthetic HTTP/WebGL fixture using real fitted meshes, camera-matched before/after poses and exact-time image sequences. Not a mission or hardware frame-rate test.
evidence_classes.native_gameplay: Separate existing normal-start living-enemy Natatorium and controller/save/material/audio/cinematic suites remain mandatory release gates.
